title: Se présenter
description: Fiche d'identité, giving your name, age, nationality, profession, marital status — a guaranteed Section B on every past paper.

title: L'heure
description: Converting between the 24-hour clock and spoken French time. Appears in nearly every past paper, often 4-6 questions.
examTags: moins le quart / et quart / et demie

title: Les adjectifs qualificatifs
description: Gender and number agreement of adjectives, including irregular forms and feminine forms of professions.

title: Le passé composé
description: Avoir vs être auxiliary verbs, DR & MRS VANDERTRAMP verbs, reflexive verbs, and past participle agreement.

title: L'imparfait
description: Describing ongoing/habitual past actions and states. Formed from the nous-stem of the present tense.

title: Le futur simple
description: Future stems (regular and irregular) plus the six future endings. Frequently tested with time expressions like 'demain' and 'la semaine prochaine'.

title: Les moyens de transport
description: Vocabulary for transport plus the tricky à/en/par choice depending on the mode of transport.

title: Prépositions de lieu
description: à, au, à la, à l', aux, chez, en, dans, par — the single most common MCQ trap on every paper.

title: Outils & équipements de protection
description: Engineering tools and personal protective equipment (PPE), and matching each tool to its function — a fixed Section A/C on recent papers.

title: Négation & nombres
description: Correct word order for ne...pas (including in passé composé and with reflexive verbs), plus writing numbers in figures.
